yt.d:
Alt. of Yt
 an old method of printing that (AS. /aet, /aet) the "y" taking
   the place of the old letter "thorn" (/). Cf. Ye, the.

yts.t: 青年训练计划（youth training scheme）

ytb.t: abbr. yarn to back 编织到背面; yield to broker 经纪商收益

ytmnd.d:
Abbreviated version of [You're the man now, dog!], a phrase said by Sean Connery in the movie Finding Forrester. In the internet subculture, however, it refers to a website in which that phrase is repeated over and over. The site is now host to thousands of similar pages which can range from amusing to disturbing, but are almost always stupid.
> "Excuse me, I believe you have my [Banana Phone]?"

ytterbia.t:
n. 氧化镱
[化] 氧化镱

ytterbic.d:
a. Pertaining to, or derived from, ytterbium; containing
   ytterbium.

ytterbite.d: n a mineral that is a source of rare earths; consists of silicates of iron and beryllium and cerium and yttrium and erbium

ytterbium.d: n. a soft silvery metallic element; a rare earth of the lanthanide series; it occurs in gadolinite and monazite and xenotime

ytterbous.t: a. [化](二价)镱的, 含(二价)镱的

yttria.t:
n. 氧化钇
[化] 三氧化二钇; 氧化钇
yttria.d: n. The oxide, Y2O3, or earth, of yttrium.

yttric.d: a. Pertaining to, derived from, or containing, yttrium.

yttriferous.t: a. 产钇的, 含钇的
yttriferous.d:
a. Bearing or containing yttrium or the allied elements;
   as, gadolinite is one of the yttriferous minerals.

yttrium.d: n. a silvery metallic element that is common in rare-earth minerals; used in magnesium and aluminum alloys
